card.name: Commas in sympathomimetic drug lists
card.fires_on: The comma between drug names in the example list after sympathomimetic agents (albuterol, epinephrine, terbutaline). Weaker hits come on a few other spots in dosing text, such as 'of' after loading infusion.

modes.label: Comma in example drug list
modes.description: Comma separating examples like albuterol and epinephrine inside an (e.g., ...) list of drug classes.
modes.example: sympathomimetic agents (e.g., albuterol, epinephrine<<,>> terbutaline), and thyroid hormones

modes.label: Dosing phrase words
modes.description: Isolated linking or mid-word spots in infusion and premedication text.
modes.example: a loading infusion<< of>> one mcg/kg over 10

card.plain: It fires on the comma between example drugs in a list of interacting drug classes, such as albuterol, epinephrine.
